rationales.partner_prior: Uniform mass makes every partner family prospectively recoverable without label favoritism.
rationales.emission_success_probabilities: Four-channel patterns distinguish contingency from soothing, intrusion, and instability in prior-predictive histories.
rationales.relational_precision_by_state: Reliable contingency carries high precision while soothing, intrusive, and unstable states remain distinct low-to-moderate regimes.
rationales.transition_stay_probability: A 0.94 stay prior permits switches while retaining enough dwell time for exact onset localization.
rationales.base_global_precision: A moderate baseline leaves prior-predictive room for broadcast to increase or decrease evidence uptake.
rationales.broadcast_strength: The dimensionless gain makes reliable-partner posterior mass capable of a visible but continuous precision shift.
rationales.root_likelihood_gain: The likelihood remains strictly positive while producing an attainable co-regulation uptake contrast.
rationales.transfer_strength: Transfer is a pure scaled readout of root-posterior movement, not a transfer-side mechanism.
